decisive_items: had been on anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years
cystoid macular edema with a yellow spot in the fovea in the right eye
Revealed cystoid macular edema with leakage in both right and left eyes
response.rationale: Chronic anastrozole exposure with bilateral CME and concurrent anterior chamber inflammation favors drug-associated CME; R4 only names the finding without etiologic link, while R5 links medication to the predominant macular pathology.

rejected.why: Describes CME as a finding but lacks the causal anastrozole association emphasized by the vignette.
Focuses on iritis but does not account for the prominent bilateral CME, which is the imaging-confirmed central issue.
Iritis is present but is a component of the presentation, not the most likely unifying diagnosis.
Uveitis is too broad and not as specific as the drug-associated CME diagnosis.
Amblyopia is a historical condition in the left eye and unrelated to the new bilateral CME and anterior segment findings.
